frequency_evidence.evidence: Required GoPro configuration QR decodes p60 (60 fps)
timestamps=start_timestamp+i_frame/fps; fps=video.average_rate; tactile is aligned to this grid
No frame downsampling; left/right tactile rotated and hconcat

notes: RGB intensity is not normal force. No grayscale conversion is used as a pressure label.
Missing chunks are invalid data, not observed zero contact.
All original numeric and identity fields are preserved; only calibrated fields may be mapped to model supervision.
The single stored tactile image horizontally concatenates two physical sensors; do not call it one contact surface.
Published processing uses BGR channels: current grayscale, 7*positive brightening, 7*positive darkening. Stored RGB reverses the channels. uint8 multiplication in original code can wrap.
Available repository calibration must be matched to sensor and recording; no unverified depth lookup is applied.
